name: tier_accuracy
description: The design's actual thesis: three items of different importance planted in one session — does the waterfall correctly sort them into core.md (durable) / notes-only (episodic) / workspace (pending human action), not just 'remember everything the same way'?

seed: Just checked the weather out of curiosity, it'll rain this afternoon. No need to remember this specifically.
From now on all code comments must be written in English. This is an explicit, standing preference — follow it every time going forward.
Remind me that rent is due next Wednesday. Only I can actually pay it, you don't need to do anything — just write a reminder file into workspace/memory/ for me.
